title: MSCI Removes Strategy (MSTR) From Its USA Index, Forcing Index Funds to Sell by Nov. 30
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

MSCI Removes Strategy (MSTR) From Its USA Index, Forcing Index Funds to Sell by Nov. 30

MSCI will take Strategy, Metaplanet, Yellow Cake, Skel and Upexi out of its global indexes as of the Nov. 30 close, after a new screen classified them as non-operating companies.

This post MSCI Removes Strategy (MSTR) From Its USA Index, Forcing Index Funds to Sell by Nov. 30 first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

How Sam Altman-Backed Meanwhile Is Disrupting the $20T Life Insurance Industry

Danny Baer, Head of Revenue & Investments at Meanwhile, explains how his Bermuda-based company built the world's first fully licensed life insurance carrier that runs entirely on Bitcoin, holding its regulatory capital in Bitcoin and paying out policies in Bitcoin.

This post How Sam Altman-Backed Meanwhile Is Disrupting the $20T Life Insurance Industry first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green.

title: MSCI Rules Today on Cutting Strategy (MSTR) From Its Indexes After a Draft List Marks It Deleted
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

MSCI Rules Today on Cutting Strategy (MSTR) From Its Indexes After a Draft List Marks It Deleted

MSCI publishes its November index review at 5 p.m. ET, the first under a new non-operating company screen. Its potential list, built on Sept. 30 filings, already marks Strategy, Metaplanet and three others as Deleted.

This post MSCI Rules Today on Cutting Strategy (MSTR) From Its Indexes After a Draft List Marks It Deleted first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.
